lead.t: Serum lactate dehydrogenase activity is markedly increased, a reflection of ineffective erythropoiesis.

snip.t: Serum lactate dehydrogenase activity is markedly increased, a reflection of ineffective erythropoiesis.
Bilirubin, increased serum lactate dehydrogenase, or serum decreased haptoglobin, indicating the presence of hemolysis, may also be obtained.
Serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) — elevated, reflects high tumour burden/turnover, used for prognosis
